from pathlib import Path
import os
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7bc84b60.py'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def transform(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
 one=next((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==1); two=next((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2)
 r,c=one; tr,tc=two; dr=1 if tr>r else -1 if tr<r else 0; dc=1 if tc>c else -1 if tc<c else 0
 # travel diagonally while both coordinates need approaching, then straight along remaining axis to adjacent target
 while r+dr != tr and c+dc != tc and dr and dc:
  r+=dr;c+=dc;out[r][c]=3
 if dr and dc:
  if r+dr==tr: # horizontal to adjacent column
   while c+dc != tc: c+=dc; out[r][c]=3
  elif c+dc==tc:
   while r+dr != tr: r+=dr;out[r][c]=3
 elif dr:
  while r+dr != tr:r+=dr;out[r][c]=3
 elif dc:
  while c+dc != tc:c+=dc;out[r][c]=3
 return out
p.write_text('def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    one = next((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1)\n    two = next((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2)\n    r,c = one; tr,tc = two\n    dr = (tr>r)-(tr<r); dc = (tc>c)-(tc<c)\n    while dr and dc and r+dr != tr and c+dc != tc:\n        r += dr; c += dc; out[r][c] = 3\n    if dr and dc:\n        if r+dr == tr:\n            while c+dc != tc: c += dc; out[r][c] = 3\n        elif c+dc == tc:\n            while r+dr != tr: r += dr; out[r][c] = 3\n    elif dr:\n        while r+dr != tr: r += dr; out[r][c] = 3\n    elif dc:\n        while c+dc != tc: c += dc; out[r][c] = 3\n    return out\n')
# generate test output
G=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)];G[1][4]=1;G[13][12]=2
O=transform(G)
print(O)
